tables.title: Where you fight it
rows: 咆哮树林、吟唱者草甸、多雨平原、轰鸣虫壳地、安眠丘陵、冰封高地、蜜脾原野

tables.title: Moves
rows: Two punches into a narrow cone in front of it、each with a short lunge. Sidestepping beats backing off、because it follows up with Swipe、which reaches farther.
A single arm sweep covering twice the angle of the punches、with longer reach、harder knockback. It follows a finished punch combo、so keep a dodge ready for it.

Once you're a few steps away it winds up、then rushes you far faster than it walks、launches whatever it hits、its own cubes included. It can only turn 20 degrees per 秒ond mid-charge、so sidestep late、it runs past.

Right after a charge it plants itself、winds up a glowing right fist、lunges into a soul punch that inflicts Soulsick. It's the hardest hit it has but covers only a narrow cone、so get to its side during the long wind-up、and expect the punch combo next if you're still close.

When you're well out of reach it fires three sculk blobs from its back in quick succession、each arcing down toward you. Every blob bursts where it lands、starts a sculk ripple、so get off the spot you were standing on.
Each projectile impact sends a ring spreading slowly outward along the ground. You can jump over it or roll through it、and it only hits you once.
It stops、roars、and 5 to 7 Sculk Cubes appear around the arena shortly after、up to 15 at a time. At 15 health each they die fast、and they share the boss's fire weakness.

Once it's at 70% health or lower、its hands glow、2 or 3 sculk catalysts rise at set spots in the arena. Any catalyst still standing when its 12-second timer runs out bursts、heals the boss、and with 22 health each they're cheap to destroy.
